description: Events in the supplied catalogue that do not fit cleanly into the other initial categories or need further classification.

source.note: Provider and meaning must be verified per event before display.

4618.headline: A monitored security event pattern occurred
4618.plain_english: Windows detected a pattern of security events that you configured for monitoring — for example, several failed logons followed by a successful one. Think of it as an alarm the system raised for you.
4618.technical_description: Security event 4618: a monitored security event pattern was detected by the Global Object Access Auditing feature.
4618.why_it_matters: This is a pre-built alert — treat it as higher priority than any single event.
normal_when: A known pattern was triggered by expected activity
suspicious_when: The pattern represents an attack sequence

severity.high: Pattern matches a known attack sequence

4618.important_note: This event is already an alert — treat as a lead, not a single event.

4931.headline: A directory service replica was modified
4931.plain_english: A copy of the Active Directory database on another domain controller was modified. Routine replication, or part of an AD-level change.
4931.technical_description: Security event 4931: a directory service replica was modified.

where.Computer: Domain controller that recorded the event

4931.why_it_matters: Unexpected replication changes can indicate AD tampering or misconfiguration.
suspicious_when: Replication changes correlated with other AD activity
4931.important_note: AD replication changes are rare — investigate unexplained ones.

4932.headline: Directory service replica synchronization began
4932.plain_english: A domain controller started synchronizing its copy of Active Directory with another domain controller.
4932.technical_description: Security event 4932: synchronization of a directory service replica began.

where.Computer: Domain controller that recorded the start

4932.why_it_matters: Usually routine, but unusual timing can indicate misconfiguration or attack.
what_to_do: Confirm the timing matches normal replication schedule

4933.headline: Directory service replica synchronization ended
4933.plain_english: A domain controller finished synchronizing its copy of Active Directory.
4933.technical_description: Security event 4933: synchronization of a directory service replica ended.

where.Computer: Domain controller that recorded the end
